node_definition.done_when: The MCP crew tool's complete and land actions call the crew_complete verb again on current main. crew_complete gained a waive_domain_check parameter (the --waive-domain-check reason string) and the tool's parameter map does not pass it, so the tool answers crew_error TypeError missing waive_domain_check. Add waive_domain_check to the complete and land entries of _PARAM_MAP and to the complete defaults in reckon/mcp_crew_actions.py with the empty-string default the other reason-string waivers use, and carry it through the crew tool's signature in reckon/mcp.py and CrewArgs in reckon/_mcp_tools.py exactly as waive_live_run is carried, so the tool can state a domain-check waiver with a reason. reckon/crew_run_commands.py is held by another run and is not edited. The four failing tests in tests/test_crew_tool_carries_the_write_verbs.py (test_each_action_matches_its_cli_verb[complete], test_each_action_matches_its_cli_verb[land], test_the_negative_control_breaks_one_action_only, test_two_commits_reach_the_promotion_as_a_list) pass, and the gate log shows them failing on the base commit. Gate, run in place on the fleet allocation with its log under the run directory: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_crew_tool_carries_the_write_verbs.py tests/test_mcp_tools.py tests/test_domain_rules_reach_the_brief.py, judged by failure delta against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the changed paths.
